data.long_description:
Spacious and well-maintained 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment located in the sought-after Burj Views community in Downtown Dubai. This bright unit offers stunning views of the iconic Burj Khalifa, creating a truly premium living experience.
..
The apartment features a generous open-plan living and dining area, a fully fitted kitchen, and a large bedroom with built-in wardrobes and an en-suite bathroom. An additional guest bathroom adds convenience, while floor-to-ceiling windows allow for plenty of natural light throughout the space.

Vacant and ready to move in, this property is ideal for both end-users and investors looking for a prime Downtown address. Residents benefit from excellent amenities, including a swimming pool, gym, landscaped gardens, and 24-hour security.

Ideally located just minutes away from Dubai Mall, restaurants, cafes, and major attractions, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and city living.
